The fantasy-point total published by Sleeper at expiration is used, with no additional rounding, and corrections after expiration are not considered.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
